{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (~qa_mask)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_parsed'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue for loyal completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_clean}")"}
